name: Fortem SkyDome System

what_it_is: SkyDome is Fortem Technologies' airspace-security system combining TrueView phased-array radar with the DroneHunter F700 interceptor drone that physically nets rogue UAS. The company joined Lockheed Martin's Sanctum counter-UAS ecosystem in 2026.
india_angle: No Indian SkyDome deployment is publicly confirmed; Fortem's net-capture approach is architecturally relevant to Indian airport and critical-site C-UAS, where hard-kill collateral risk is constrained.
intelligence_assessment: Product record is verifiable via the OEM and dronelife-class coverage. India remains analytical; watch Indian airport-security procurements for net-interceptor classes.

faq.a: It fires nets at hostile drones and tows them away - a physical-capture alternative to jamming or guns.
